refs.note: The notice prints 'Date et niveau de protection de l'édifice 1992/09/03 : classé MH' and records that an earlier 'Inscription 17 01 1926 (arrêté)' was annulled. note: Tranche 3, 5 Sep 2026, ADDED BY THIS TRANCHE. The node's own prose names this building as the proof of its central claim - 'the compositional discipline underneath is real and independent of the dress, which is why the same method produced buildings as different as Garnier's Opera and Labrouste's iron-vaulted Bibliotheque Sainte-Genevieve' - and the node carried no exemplar for it. THE REGISTER SAYS NOTHING ABOUT THE IRON. It states the architect, two campaign years, one decor technique and the protection, and no material, no dimension, no vault and no bay count. The building the corpus cites for iron inside masonry has, from the register, no recorded structure at all. No rights line was read, so no `rights_evidence`.
